verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਘਰ ਲਾਗੈ ਆਗਿ ਭਾਗਿ ਨਿਕਸਤ ਖਾਨ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਪਰੋਸੀ ਧਾਇ ਜਰਤ ਬੁਝਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise ghar laagai aag bhaag nikasat khaan preetam parosee dhai jarat bujhaaviee ||

en.bdb: As the owner of the house that catches fire escapes from the inferno to save his life, but sympathetic neighbours and friends rush to put the fire off,

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਧਨ ਹਰਤ ਜੈਸੇ ਕਰਤ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਗੋਪ ਗਾਉ ਮੈ ਗੁਹਾਰ ਲਾਗਿ ਤੁਰਤ ਛਡਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: godhan harat jaise karat pukaar gop gaau mai guhaar laag turat chhaddaaviee ||

en.bdb: As a herdsman shouts for help when his cattle are being stolen, the village folks chase the thieves and recover the cattle,

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੂਡਤ ਅਥਾਹ ਜੈਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਬਲ ਪ੍ਰਵਾਹ ਬਿਖੈ ਪੇਖਤ ਪੈਰਊਆ ਵਾਰ ਪਾਰ ਲੈ ਲਗਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: booddat athaeh jaise prabal pravaeh bikhai pekhat pairuooaa vaar paar lai lagaaviee ||

en.bdb: As a person may be drowning in rapid and deep water and an expert swimmer rescues him and reaches him on the other bank to safety,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਅੰਤਕਾਲ ਜਮ ਜਾਲ ਕਾਲ ਬਿਆਲ ਗ੍ਰਸੇ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਕਟ ਮਿਟਾਵਹੀ ॥੧੬੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise a(n)takaal jam jaal kaal biaal grase gursikh saadh sa(n)t sa(n)kaT miTaavahee ||167||

en.bdb: Similarly, when death-like snake is entangling a person in the throes of death, seeking help of saintly and holy persons allay that distress. (167)
